authority_status: BringFido is NEVER publication authority. No policy fact in the Atlas authority derives from it. Every row it suggested still requires deterministic identity binding and first-party policy evidence before it can be admitted.

cost.how: attended Chrome plus same-origin fetch; BringFido refuses an ordinary static GET with HTTP 403, and no paid lane was used to get past it

capture.capture_completeness: complete for this surface: pagination was walked until the server stopped returning a page, and the last page returned 10 rather than 20 rows
capture.why_122_and_169_disagree: MECHANICAL, not a capture failure. Of the 169 properties the paginated hotel cohort serves, exactly 122 carry addressLocality 'Indianapolis' in BringFido's own JSON-LD. The headline 122 counts the city string; the cohort it actually serves includes the surrounding market -- Plainfield 11, Carmel 7, Fishers 7, Greenwood 4, Whitestown 4, Brownsburg 3, Noblesville 3, Westfield 1, Avon 1, Franklin 1, and 5 listings with no address at all.

a_second_and_larger_discrepancy.finding: the UNFILTERED lodging page claims 'There are 248 pet friendly hotels in Indianapolis' while serving every lodging type, including vacation rentals and campgrounds
a_second_and_larger_discrepancy.why: the type filter is a PATH segment, not a query parameter. /lodging/city/indianapolis_in_us/?type=hotels is inert -- it returns byte-identical results to ?type=campgrounds and ?type=rentals -- while /lodging/hotels/city/indianapolis_in_us/ is the real hotel surface and reports 122.
a_second_and_larger_discrepancy.how_it_was_caught: the same page-1 identity set came back for four different type values; a filter that changes nothing is not a filter
a_second_and_larger_discrepancy.consequence_if_missed: a competitor census taken from the query-parameter URL would have compared 329 mixed-category lodging rows against a hotel census and reported a fictitious gap

reconciliation_method.authority: the pinned Atlas identity census of 263
reconciliation_method.name_is_never_a_binding: name similarity was computed only as a DIAGNOSTIC to find rows the address matcher had missed, and it proved the point: it paired 'Motel 6 Southport' with 'motel 6 indianapolis airport', 'Home2 Suites Fishers' with 'home2 suites indianapolis northwest' and 'Spark Fishers' with 'hilton garden inn northeast fishers'. Every one is a different building. No pairing was promoted to a match.
reconciliation_method.a_substring_is_not_a_match: street/postal substring tests were run against the page's DECLARED address fields, never against the raw document -- on a multi-property brand index, a raw substring test reports a match for a building that is not there

not_lodging_but_filed_under_hotels.detail: two are category landing pages rather than properties at all ('Indianapolis Airbnb Rentals', 'VRBO Indianapolis'); two are bed & breakfasts; and six are apartment or whole-house short-term rentals ('CozySuites at Artistry Indy', 'CozySuites at Bottleworks District', 'CozySuites at East Washington', 'The Residences at CityWay', 'Urban Chic Townhome Near Downtown', 'Artisan Oasis-Hot Tub Fire Pit 8BD Whole House')
not_lodging_but_filed_under_hotels.significance: 5.9% of the competitor's own hotel category is not a hotel. Any count taken from it without category adjudication is inflated by that much before geography is even considered.

outside_atlas_geography.detail: three Whitestown 46075 properties and one Whitestown 46275 (the Zionsville corridor, excluded from this market by the market contract and settled by founder ruling F-004-3, which must not be reopened), one Franklin 46131, and one listing whose stated city is Plainfield but whose postal 46148 is Greenfield
outside_atlas_geography.significance: these are not Atlas coverage gaps; they are a different market boundary

reverse_check_atlas_against_bringfido.purpose: BringFido is not assumed to be ground truth, so the comparison was run in both directions
reverse_check_atlas_against_bringfido.reading: the competitor is missing 10 hotels Atlas has already verified and published as pet-friendly, and it lists 3 properties as pet-friendly for which Atlas holds a citable first-party refusal. Completeness runs in both directions, and on accuracy the disagreements found so far favour Atlas.
